protocol.scope: Actual PostgreSQL versioned tables/GIN,validation and pointer activation; current ACL separate from content revisions. No model,ANN,latency/load or production deployment claim.
protocol.corpora: Original12documents v1; v2 replaces the two cache documents with revision2,Alpha450/Beta75. First build omits beta-restoration-v1,then inserts it. Expected content written before execution.
protocol.activation: Under SHARE lock on candidate table,compare exact IDs and canonical content SHA256. Conditional UPDATE pointer requires expected active content hash; invalid/incomplete or stale promotion rolls back. Application has no write grants.
protocol.overlap: Old alpha_reader request opens RR readonly,reads principal/pointerv1 before activation; new request opens after activation and readsv2; then old request rereads pointerv1 and loads old table after new request. Two overlapping transactions with deterministic interleaving,not concurrent-load benchmark.
protocol.cache: 11 retrieval requests,4hits/7misses. Namespace includes selected generation content hash and accessRevision. TTL60000ms; no expiry claim. Principal/state first read in same snapshot as source lookup.
protocol.citations: Nine authored references across two generations,wrong revision,foreign tenant and unknown generation. Current document_acl keyed by tenant+document_key gates both tables,so old copied access_level cannot authorize a newly restricted document.
protocol.acl: After activev2,alpha cache access becomes1 and global epoch becomes2 in one committed admin transaction. Old content remains immutable. Readers denied both revisions;manager resolves both. No trigger enforces every admin path or instantaneous revocation within older snapshots.
protocol.limits: Full small documents,no byte/fragment citation offsets. Application read-only and tested publisher preserve contents;admins can still edit after validation. No automated garbage collection,backup,failover,distributed cache,rollback-to-v1 or generator evaluation.
protocol.preservation: Existing success/failure artifact refuses overwrite; changed sources need new protocol/path.

runtime.network: loopback ephemeral port; temporary synthetic databases only
runtime.authentication: trust ONLY in disposable loopback lab; not a deployment configuration

SELECT d.id,d.tenant,d.document_key,d.revision,d.body,
    d.access_level AS stored_access_level,a.access_level,
    ts_rank(d.terms,plainto_tsquery('simple',$1),0) AS score
    FROM documents d JOIN document_acl a
      ON a.tenant=d.tenant AND a.document_key=d.document_key
    WHERE d.terms @@ plainto_tsquery('simple',$1)
    ORDER BY score DESC,d.id ASC LIMIT $2
